summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 4.I/250)

data.turoyo: Bəṯər mayo ʕwədli mədde yarəxto, ṭabʕan bi məddaṯe aḥna, aš šutosayḏan d mʔasaslan as səryoye kulle w kmətyaqanno a ḥrene ste, u asas diḏa, bi goluṯo, d qudrina mḥafḏina ʕal aʕ ʕadat diḏan w at taqalit diḏan.
data.translation: After that I worked a long time. Of course, during this period our institutions that all we Syriacs founded, and I am convinced the others too, their foundation, in exile, was that we might be able to preserve our customs and our traditions.

summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense D1 in Part. Pass. (Jan 2.4/485)

data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: E. Meqəm mʔasasto wa, bas mərwiwola. Annaqqa saymiwo bote biyya, maʕlanwolən w bunanwo biyya. D kətwayye qaṭoʕe d kefe, naḥode, d kətwayye maʕmərone, ṭranne b Məḏyaḏ.
data.translation: Father Brahim: Yes. They had been founded before, but they were enlarging them. Now they were making houses in them, raising them and building in them. Those who were stonecutters, stone dressers, those who were builders, they left them in Midyat.

rationale: First Detransitive Part. Pass. example; feminine result predicate plus separate wa contrasts with eventive founding. Jan translation is machine-generated.
